categories.name: Damage & Damage-over-Time
categories.summary: Direct HP hits, bleed/poison/burn/stress DoTs, and lifesteal — the ways to deal harm.

categories.name: Healing & Cleanse
categories.summary: Restore HP (flat or %), heal-over-time, stress-heal, and cure/cleanse of DoTs and debuffs.

categories.name: Buffs & Debuffs
categories.summary: Modify the 10 combat stats (dodge/prot/speed/damage/crit/acc/HP/riposte) inline, or apply named buffs from buffs.json.

categories.name: Control & Lock-down
categories.summary: Stun, daze, mark/tag, guard, stealth, immobilize/root, mind-control, riposte — apply a status or lock an actor down.

categories.name: Status Removal
categories.summary: Strip stun, mark, stealth, root, guard, control, riposte, debuffs, or virtue from an actor.

categories.name: Movement & Positioning
categories.summary: Push, pull, shuffle a single target or a whole party, and immediate reposition variants.

categories.name: Kill & Execute
categories.summary: Instakill / execute mechanics, optionally restricted to monster types.

categories.name: Torch & Light
categories.summary: Raise or lower the dungeon light meter.

categories.name: Summon & Spawn
categories.summary: Conjure adds — the positionally-paired summon family that spawns monster classes.

categories.name: Transform & Stance
categories.summary: Swap an actor's monster class (boss transforms) or shift the actor into a declared mode/stance.

categories.name: Steal Buffs
categories.summary: Transfer matching buffs from an enemy target to the performer.

categories.name: Turn Economy & Meta
categories.summary: Bonus actions, initiative changes, skill-use refreshes, and trigger-limit adjustments.

categories.name: Curio, Quirk, Item & Utility
categories.summary: Inflict quirks/diseases, grant/destroy trinkets, use items, capture, curio flags, and Crimson-Court special verbs.

categories.name: Conditional Gates & Riders
categories.summary: Riders that decide whether a payload lands: vs-type, burning gate, on-corpse/death, role-swap, rank/inventory conditions.

categories.name: Universal Frame Fields
categories.summary: The scaffolding every legal effect carries: name, target, chance, on_hit/on_miss, queue, duration, curio_result_type, apply_once, and value-domain catalogs.

categories.name: Skill-Line Fields (NOT effects)
categories.summary: Fields that read like effects in design talk but live on the combat_skill line, not in an effect record: free-cast, ignore-stealth, move-on-use, valid_modes, launch/target geometry.

effects.name: Bleed DoT
effects.summary: Applies a bleed damage-over-time on the target, ticking each round for the number of rounds set by .duration. Scaled by target bleed resist/mods.

params.desc: Number of rounds the DoT ticks (required).

effects.name: Poison / Blight DoT
effects.summary: Applies a blight (poison) damage-over-time, ticking each round; gated by target poison resist.

effects.name: Burn DoT
effects.summary: Applies a burn damage-over-time (Color of Madness). Amount is multiplied by 1.5 (ceil) on a crit. Scaled by burn resist/mods.

effects.name: Stress-over-Time
effects.summary: Ticks stress on the target each round. Unlike instant .stress, this DoT does NOT require .queue.

examples.note: Ticks 2 stress/round for 3 rounds; no queue needed.

effects.name: Shuffle-over-Time
effects.summary: Periodic forced reposition over time — applies a shuffle each round while the DoT is active.

effects.name: Heal-over-Time (Regen)
effects.summary: A round-scoped positive heal-over-time tick (regen), applying heal-received mods. For a battle-long regen banner, use a buffs.json hp_dot_heal buff via buff_ids instead.

effects.name: DoT Source Tag
effects.summary: Buff::Source id used when the DoT is applied — identifies who/what applied it. Resolves against the same 34-entry bsrc_* table as buff_source_type.

params.desc: One of the 34 bsrc_* source ids (e.g. bsrc_skill, bsrc_trinket, bsrc_quirk). 0x22 = not-found.

examples.note: Tags the DoT as skill-sourced for stacking/clearing rules.

effects.name: Irresistible DoT
effects.summary: When true, the DoT skips the resistance roll — it always lands regardless of the target's resist.

params.desc: Bool. If true the DoT ignores resist rolls.

examples.note: A bleed that ignores bleed resist.

effects.name: Named Actor-DoT
effects.summary: Selects a named actor-DoT definition (by string, hashed to an id) applied at runtime. A pre-defined DoT record rather than an inline bleed/poison/burn.

params.desc: String id of the actor-DoT definition to apply.

effects.name: Stress (Instant)
effects.summary: Deals that much stress to the target immediately (the vanilla 'Stress N' effects). MUST be .queue'd — verified 66/66 vanilla stress effects are queued.

params.desc: Amount of stress to deal now.
Required — instant stress must be queued.

effects.name: Direct HP Damage
effects.summary: A flat HP hit outside the normal weapon roll (bypass path). Pair with .damage_type and .damage_source_type for attribution.

examples.note: 5 flat HP outside the weapon roll, attributed as an effect source.

effects.name: HP Damage Blocks
effects.summary: Number of damage blocks to grant/deal. Stored on the struct; consumed downstream (not executed in the core apply fn).

effects.name: Lifedrain (Lifesteal)
effects.summary: The performer heals for approximately this much of the damage dealt (life-steal on hit). Hash-dispatched field — parse mechanism code-confirmed, semantics data-derived.

params.desc: Lifedrain amount (share of damage the performer recovers).

examples.note: Performer heals from the damage dealt.

effects.name: Anti-Heal AoE
effects.summary: Applies anti-heal (healing-received-down) across AoE targets. Hash-dispatched field; semantics data-derived.

examples.note: Reduces healing received across an AoE.

effects.name: Debuff Enemy
effects.summary: Routes the effect's debuff onto an enemy target. Hash-dispatched field; semantics data-derived.

examples.note: Routes the debuff onto the enemy.

effects.name: Heal (Flat)
effects.summary: Heals the target by a flat amount. Add .can_crit_heal true to allow heal crits; .source_heal_type tags/scales the heal.

examples.note: Flat 4 HP heal from a hero skill.

effects.name: Heal (Percent of Max HP)
effects.summary: Heals the target for a fraction of (max) HP. Same crit/heal-source path as .heal.

params.desc: Fraction of max HP to restore (e.g. 0.25).

effects.name: Allow Heal Crit
effects.summary: When true, the heal component of this effect can critically hit (heal for extra).

effects.name: Heal Source Type
effects.summary: Tags where a heal is attributed/scaled from. Passed into the heal applier for both .heal and .heal_percent. 15 values (Heal::Action::Types).

params.desc: One of: hero_skill, hero_skill_multi_target, monster_skill, monster_skill_multi_target, camp_skill, camp_skill_multi_target, effect, act_out, curio, eat, companion, debug, dot, flashback, damage_heal.

examples.note: Tags a party heal for correct scaling.

effects.name: Stress Heal
effects.summary: Reduces (heals) the target's stress by that amount.

effects.name: Cure (Poison + Bleed)
effects.summary: If value >= 1, cures BOTH poison AND bleed DoTs on the target (a combined cure). If absent/<1, falls through to the individual cure fields.

params.desc: Cure magnitude (>= 1 triggers the combined poison+bleed cure).

effects.name: Cure Poison
effects.summary: Removes poison/blight DoTs on the target (RemoveDOTpoison).

effects.name: Cure Bleed
effects.summary: Removes bleed DoTs on the target (RemoveDOTbleeding).

effects.name: Cure Burn
effects.summary: Removes burn DoTs on the target (RemoveDOTburning).

effects.name: Cure Disease
effects.summary: Cures a disease on the target. Parser-confirmed valid but unused in base data.

examples.note: Removes a disease from the target.

effects.name: Clear DoT-Stress
effects.summary: Clears the target's DoT-stress (RemoveDOTstress) — the 'snap them out of horror' tool.

effects.name: Clear Debuffs
effects.summary: Strips N debuffs from the target (whichever are clear-debuff-valid).

examples.note: Removes one debuff from the target.

effects.name: Combat Stat Buff / Debuff
effects.summary: The workhorse. A flag that this effect is an inline combat-stat buff; carries 2-4 stat mutators (each with _add flat and _multiply scalar). Positive = buff, negative = debuff. One of the mutually-exclusive buff payloads (buff_ids / buff_type / combat_stat_buff / riposte).

params.desc: Flag marking this an inline stat buff.
One or more of the 10 stats' _add/_multiply tokens (see below).
Round-scoped, or .duration 1 .buff_duration_type combat_end for a battle-long banner.

examples.note: A damage-swing debuff needs both bounds; one effect bundles the pair.

effects.name: Min Damage (flat)
effects.summary: Combat-stat-buff sub-token: flat additive to the low damage bound while the buff is active. Reached only via .combat_stat_buff.

effects.name: Min Damage (%)
effects.summary: Combat-stat-buff sub-token: multiplicative modifier to the low damage bound (scalar around 1.0; 0.15 = +15%, -0.20 = -20% weaken). Usually paired with damage_high_multiply.

effects.name: Max Damage (flat)
effects.summary: Combat-stat-buff sub-token: flat additive to the high damage bound while the buff is active.

effects.name: Max Damage (%)
effects.summary: Combat-stat-buff sub-token: multiplicative modifier to the high damage bound. Standard pair with damage_low_multiply for a full damage swing.

effects.name: Dodge (flat)
effects.summary: Combat-stat-buff sub-token: flat additive to defense/dodge rating (player term DODGE, cap 100). Negative value lowers dodge.

effects.name: Protection (flat)
effects.summary: Combat-stat-buff sub-token: flat additive to protection rating (player term PROT, cap 100). Reached via .combat_stat_buff.

effects.name: Speed (flat)
effects.summary: Combat-stat-buff sub-token: additive mutator of the speed_rating stat (player term SPD). Enters effects only via .combat_stat_buff.

effects.name: Accuracy (flat)
effects.summary: Combat-stat-buff sub-token: flat additive to attack rating (player term ACC). A negative value is 'blind'. Reached via .combat_stat_buff.

params.desc: Flat add to accuracy; negative = blind.

effects.name: Crit (flat)
effects.summary: Combat-stat-buff sub-token: flat additive modifier to crit chance while the buff is active.

effects.name: Crit Rating (alias)
effects.summary: Alias of the crit stat's add component (.crit_chance_add) — not a separate stat. Canonical name is crit_chance; verify token spelling against actual .effects.darkest data.

params.desc: Flat add to crit (treat as crit_chance_add).

effects.name: Max HP (flat)
effects.summary: Combat-stat-buff sub-token for the max_hp stat (player term HP). Registered but never used inline in vanilla (0 uses) — author HP buffs as a buffs.json entry via buff_ids instead.

examples.note: Prefer a buffs.json HP buff over an inline max_hp mutator.

effects.name: Max HP (%)
effects.summary: Combat-stat-buff sub-token: multiplicative modifier to max HP. Valid only via .combat_stat_buff; like max_hp_add, unused inline in vanilla — prefer a buffs.json buff.

effects.name: Riposte-on-Hit Chance (flat)
effects.summary: Combat-stat-buff sub-token: additive modifier to the chance the actor ripostes when hit. Reached only via .combat_stat_buff.

effects.name: Riposte-on-Miss Chance (flat)
effects.summary: Combat-stat-buff sub-token: additive modifier to the chance the actor ripostes when an attack misses it. Reached only via .combat_stat_buff.

effects.name: Named Buffs (buff_ids)
effects.summary: Applies up to 8 named buff ids defined in shared/buffs/<mod>.buffs.json. Use when the buff needs a rule_type gate (only-while-X), a specific duration_type, cross-file reuse, a resistance buff, or the wider stat palette. This is how a skill gains buff-only powers.

params.desc: Up to 8 space/quote-delimited buff ids from buffs.json.

examples.note: A battle-long regen banner via a buffs.json buff.

effects.name: Buff Clear-Debuff-Valid
effects.summary: Whether this buff is eligible to be cleared by a clear-debuff effect.

effects.name: Inline Buff Type
effects.summary: Selects the combat-stat buff category for a one-off inline buff authored without a buffs.json entry. Gates reading of .buff_sub_type and .buff_amount. One of the mutually-exclusive buff payloads.

params.desc: Buff stat category (validated vs the stat_type table).

examples.note: An inline single-stat buff; amount must be > 0.

effects.name: Inline Buff Sub-Type
effects.summary: Sub-type companion to inline .buff_type / .buff_amount, narrowing the buff's domain.

params.desc: Sub-type domain for the inline buff.

effects.name: Inline Buff Amount
effects.summary: Magnitude of the inline .buff_type buff. Only read when .buff_type is set; the parser errors if buff_type is set but amount == 0.

effects.name: Buff Duration Type
effects.summary: Controls how long the buff lasts (round vs combat_end vs quest_end etc). If absent AND any dot/dmg field is set, defaults to 8. Used with .duration for a battle-long banner.

params.desc: One of: round, combat_end, quest_end, quest_complete, activity_end, idle_start_town_visit, ... (11 values).

effects.name: Buff Source Type
effects.summary: Categorizes the buff's source (drives stacking & clearing rules). 34 values (bsrc_*).

params.desc: One of 34 bsrc_* ids (e.g. bsrc_skill, bsrc_trinket, bsrc_quirk, bsrc_riposte).

effects.name: Riposte (grant)
effects.summary: Grants the Riposte status: the actor counter-hits attackers. Requires .duration. The .riposte_effect names the sub-effect applied by the counter. One of the mutually-exclusive buff payloads.

examples.note: Grants a 3-round riposte with a custom counter payload.

effects.name: Riposte Sub-Effect
effects.summary: Sub-field of .riposte — the effect id the riposte counter-hit applies when it triggers.

params.desc: Name of the effect the counter applies.

examples.note: Riposte that applies a bleed on counter.

effects.name: Riposte Validate
effects.summary: Gates whether a riposte grant is validated (a validate flag read elsewhere; note the trailing space in the parser token).

params.desc: Bool. Validate flag for the riposte grant.

effects.name: Stun
effects.summary: Accumulates into the target's stun meter (takes max). MUST be .queue'd. Resisted by target Stun resist. Fires applied/resisted events.

params.desc: Stun value added to the meter.

effects.name: Daze (apply)
effects.summary: Applies the Daze status (Fire's Edge; parallels stun). Parser-valid but UNUSED in vanilla base — usable-but-unproven. Like stun, treat as must-be-queued.

effects.name: Mark / Tag
effects.summary: Applies the Marked status. A self-mark (.target performer) draws fire (mark-seeking enemies prefer marked heroes); marking an enemy enables ally vs-marked bonuses. Blocked if target is stealthed.

examples.note: Marks an enemy for vs-marked bonuses.

effects.name: Guard
effects.summary: The performer guards the targeted ally, redirecting hits to the guardian. Needs performer != target and .duration. To make an ally guard the performer instead, add .swap_source_and_target true.

params.desc: Required — how long the guard lasts.

effects.name: Stealth
effects.summary: Grants the Stealth status to the target. Removed with .unstealth.

effects.name: Immobilize / Root
effects.summary: Locks the target's rank (immobilized flag). Cleared with .unimmobilize.

examples.note: Prevents the target from being moved / moving.

effects.name: Mind Control
effects.summary: Take control of the target for N turns. Must NOT be .queue'd (validator warns). Released with .uncontrol.

params.desc: Number of turns to control (must not be queued).

examples.note: Takes control of the target for 1 turn; never queued.

effects.name: Controlled Burn Amount
effects.summary: Amount for the 'controlled burn' mechanic (paired with controlled_burn_duration).

effects.name: Controlled Burn Duration
effects.summary: Duration for the controlled-burn mechanic.

effects.name: Remove Stun
effects.summary: Resets the target's stun meter to 0 and clears the stun state.

effects.name: Remove Daze
effects.summary: Clears the Daze status (parallels unstun; Fire's Edge). Parser-valid but unused in base.

effects.name: Remove Mark
effects.summary: Removes the Marked/tagged status (inverse of .tag).

examples.note: Removes a mark from the target.

effects.name: Remove Stealth
effects.summary: Removes the Stealth status (inverse of .stealth).

effects.name: Remove Immobilize
effects.summary: Clears the target's immobilized flag (inverse of .immobilize).

effects.name: Release Control
effects.summary: Releases a .control (mind-control). Parser-confirmed valid.

effects.name: Clear Guarding
effects.summary: Clears the 'guarding' status on the guardian side (stops the actor from guarding).

effects.name: Clear Guarded
effects.summary: Clears the 'being guarded' status on the target (removes the protection it was receiving).

examples.note: Removes the guard protecting the target.

effects.name: Clear Riposte
effects.summary: Removes the Riposte status from the target.

effects.name: Clear Virtue
effects.summary: Strips Virtue from the target. Parser-confirmed valid but unused in base data.

effects.name: Remove Vampire (Crimson Curse)
effects.summary: Removes the vampire (Crimson Curse) affliction/level. NOT a combat effect proper — a town/estate effect-type that strips the Crimson Curse.

effects.name: Push (Knockback)
effects.summary: Moves the target forward (toward rank 1). Shares one net-move slot with pull. Move effects must NOT be queued and must set .can_apply_on_death true.

examples.note: Shoves the target one rank forward.

effects.name: Pull (Drag)
effects.summary: Moves the target backward. Stored as a negative net-move; shares the push/pull slot. Move effects must NOT be queued and must set .can_apply_on_death true.

examples.note: Drags the target two ranks back.

effects.name: Shuffle Target
effects.summary: Repositions one target actor to a weighted-random rank. Takes priority over shuffleparty. Move effect — must not be queued, set can_apply_on_death.

examples.note: Moves the single target to a random rank.

effects.name: Shuffle Party
effects.summary: Scrambles the target's whole party formation. shuffletarget overrides this if both present. Move effect.

effects.name: Instant Shuffle
effects.summary: Forces the shuffle-target path and marks it instant — an immediate (non-queued) reposition variant instead of a queued knockback.

params.desc: Presence-only token; forces +0x35=1 and instant path.

effects.name: Kill / Execute
effects.summary: Rolls vs .chance to force-kill the target (sets HP to -1, fires MonsterDeathEvent). Restrict with .kill_enemy_types and gate with .requires_kill_target.

effects.name: Kill Enemy Types
effects.summary: Restricts a .kill to a set of monster-type ids (up to 4).

params.desc: Up to 4 monster-type ids the kill applies to.

effects.name: Requires Kill Target
effects.summary: Condition: the effect only applies if the target is a valid kill target.

examples.note: Gates the kill to valid targets.

effects.name: Torch Increase
effects.summary: Raises the light meter. MUST be .queue'd.

params.desc: Required — torch effects must be queued.

effects.name: Torch Decrease
effects.summary: Lowers the light meter. MUST be .queue'd.

params.desc: Required — torch effects must be queued.

effects.name: Summon Monsters
effects.summary: The core of the summon family: names up to 4 monster-class ids to spawn, each combined with its chance/rank/limit/roll into a weighted summon table. Must target performer.

params.desc: Up to 4 monster-class ids (positionally paired with the rest of the summon family).

examples.note: Spawns one of two skeleton classes.

effects.name: Summon Chances
effects.summary: Up to 4 floats, positionally paired with summon_monsters — the weighted pick chance of each summon table row.

params.desc: Up to 4 chance weights, one per monster.

examples.note: First monster 3x as likely as the second.

effects.name: Summon Count
effects.summary: Number of monsters to spawn (drives how many weighted picks occur). A summon with count 0 warns.

effects.name: Summon Ranks
effects.summary: Up to 4 rank-strings (e.g. '1', '2', '12'), positionally paired — which rank(s) each summon may occupy.

examples.note: Both summons appear in the back ranks.

effects.name: Summon Limits
effects.summary: Up to 4 ints — caps how many of each monster class may exist on the field; entries at/over their limit are skipped in the pick.

params.desc: Max field count per summon class.

examples.note: Caps the first class at 2; second is uncapped (0).

effects.name: Summon Rolls Initiative
effects.summary: Up to 4 bools — whether each summoned monster rolls into the current initiative order.

params.desc: Per-summon: rolls into initiative this round or not.

effects.name: Summon Erase-on-Roll
effects.summary: When set, the chosen summon entry is spliced out of the pool after use so it can't be rolled again.

params.desc: Bool. Remove the entry once picked.

examples.note: Each entry can only be summoned once.

effects.name: Summon Can Spawn Loot
effects.summary: Flag on summoned monsters controlling whether they can drop loot on death.

params.desc: Bool. Summons drop loot or not.

effects.name: Summon Rank = Previous Class
effects.summary: When set, the summoned monster inherits the rank/position of the monster class it replaced, rather than an explicit rank.

params.desc: Bool. Inherit the previous class's rank.

examples.note: Spawns in the replaced monster's slot.

effects.name: Spawn Target Actor Base Class
effects.summary: Identifies the base monster class to spawn as the effect's target actor (stored as a hash). The spawn consumer lives outside the core fns.

params.desc: Base monster class id to spawn.

examples.note: Spawns a specific base class as the target.

effects.name: Spawn Sycophant
effects.summary: Summons Sycophant add(s) (Crimson Court). Hash-dispatched field; semantics data-derived.

effects.name: Set Mode / Stance
effects.summary: Switches the actor into a declared mode. At runtime scans the actor's mode list for a match and switches. Pair with the skill's .valid_modes to gate which skills work per stance (the Thorn/Cook stance pattern).

params.desc: Name of a declared mode on the actor (<=64 bytes).

examples.note: Switches the actor into the aggressive stance.

effects.name: Set Monster Class (single)
effects.summary: Swaps the target's monster class to a single class id (chance 1.0). Used only if .set_monster_class_ids is absent. A boss transform mechanic.

params.desc: The monster class id to transform into.

effects.name: Set Monster Class (weighted list)
effects.summary: Up to 8 class-id strings, each weighted by .set_monster_class_chances; one is rolled. Takes precedence over the singular set_monster_class_id.

params.desc: Up to 8 class ids, paired positionally with chances.

examples.note: Randomly transforms into one of two forms.

effects.name: Set Monster Class Chances
effects.summary: Up to 8 float weights, positionally paired with set_monster_class_ids — cumulative-chance roll selects the class.

effects.name: Class Swap: Reset HP
effects.summary: When set, resets HP on the class swap. Combines with carry_over_hp_min_percent for a floor.

examples.note: New form starts at full HP.

effects.name: Class Swap: Reset Buffs
effects.summary: When set, strips buffs/stat overrides during the class swap.

effects.name: Class Swap: Reset Scale
effects.summary: When set, resets the monster's visual/size scale on swap.

params.desc: Bool. Reset visual scale during transform.

effects.name: Class Swap: Clear Initiative
effects.summary: When set, clears initiative on the class swap. (Spelling 'initative' is verbatim in the game data.)

effects.name: Class Swap: Clear Brain Cooldowns
effects.summary: When set, clears the monster's brain/skill cooldowns during the class swap.

params.desc: Bool. Clear AI/skill cooldowns during transform.

examples.note: New form's skills are all off cooldown.

effects.name: Class Swap: HP Carry-over Floor
effects.summary: HP-carryover floor on the monster-class swap (minimum % HP the new form starts with). Parser-confirmed valid, unused in base.

params.desc: Minimum HP fraction carried into the new form.

examples.note: New form starts with at least 50% HP.

effects.name: Transform to Vampire
effects.summary: Transforms the performer into the vampiric (Crimson Curse) form. Hash-dispatched (Crimson Court); semantics data-derived.

examples.note: Turns the performer into the vampire form.

effects.name: Steal Buff (by stat)
effects.summary: Names a stat-type category to steal from the target's buffs, transferring matching buffs to the performer. .target must be an enemy (target / target_group / target_group_other).

params.desc: Stat-type category of buff to steal.

examples.note: Steals dodge buffs from the enemy.

effects.name: Steal Buff (by source)
effects.summary: Installs a steal-buff predicate matching a source category and transfers those buffs from target to performer. .target must be an enemy.

params.desc: Source category (bsrc_*) of buff to steal.

examples.note: Steals skill-sourced buffs off the enemy.

effects.name: Bonus Action Next Turn
effects.summary: Grants the target a bonus action next turn.

params.desc: Bool. Grant an extra action next turn.

effects.name: Initiative Change
effects.summary: Delta to actor initiative — moves them earlier/later in turn order.

examples.note: Bumps the performer up the turn order.

effects.name: Refresh Skill Uses
effects.summary: Refreshes limited (per-battle) skill uses.

effects.name: Trigger Limit Max +
effects.summary: Raises the maximum trigger-limit counter on the buff/effect's trigger tracking.

params.desc: Amount to raise the max trigger limit.

effects.name: Trigger Limit Min +
effects.summary: Raises the minimum trigger-limit counter.

params.desc: Amount to raise the min trigger limit.

effects.name: Inflict Quirk / Disease
effects.summary: Grants a named quirk to the target — NOT disease-restricted; the id can be positive/negative/disease (resolves against the single global quirk library). .disease "any" is the only disease-FILTERED form (random from the disease pool). Field name is historical.

params.desc: A quirk/disease id, or "any" for a random disease.

effects.name: Gain Random Negative Quirk
effects.summary: When true, the target gains a random negative quirk.

params.desc: Bool. Grant a random negative quirk.

effects.name: Gain Random Positive Quirk (%)
effects.summary: Percent chance to grant a random positive quirk.

params.desc: Percent chance to add a positive quirk.

examples.note: 50% chance to add a positive quirk.

effects.name: Gain Trinket (specific)
effects.summary: Grants a specific trinket by id. Town/inventory-side; not executed in the combat apply fn.

effects.name: Gain Random Trinket
effects.summary: Grants a random trinket from a rarity/pool id. Town/inventory-side.

params.desc: Trinket rarity/pool id to draw from.

effects.name: Destroy Trinket
effects.summary: When true, destroys a trinket on the target.

examples.note: Destroys a trinket held by the target.

effects.name: Use Item (type)
effects.summary: Names the item category/type to consume/use. Requires .use_item_id alongside it.

effects.name: Use Item (id)
effects.summary: Identifies which item to consume/use. Requires .use_item_type alongside it.

effects.name: Capture / Abduct
effects.summary: Capture amount/flag (Shrieker-style 'capture into party' mechanic). Pair with capture_remove_from_party.

effects.name: Capture: Remove From Party
effects.summary: Whether/how many party members are removed on capture.

params.desc: Members removed from party on capture.

examples.note: Removes the captured member from the party.

effects.name: Crimson Harvest
effects.summary: Crimson Court blood-harvest mechanic. Hash-dispatched; semantics data-derived.

effects.name: Crimson Swarm
effects.summary: Spawn / advance the Crimson swarm. Hash-dispatched; semantics data-derived.

effects.name: Blood Counter
effects.summary: Increments a blood/curse counter token on the actor. Hash-dispatched (Crimson Court); semantics data-derived.

effects.name: Viscount Feed Corpse
effects.summary: Viscount boss: consume a corpse to heal/empower. Hash-dispatched (Crimson Court); semantics data-derived.

effects.name: Curio Flag
effects.summary: Marks/flags the effect as a curio-interaction result (curio bool/count). Full runtime consumption is outside the core fns.

examples.note: Marks the effect as a curio result.

effects.name: Curio Result Type
effects.summary: Names the curio result category (tooltip colour + curio bucket). Code-certain 4 values: negative(0), neutral(1, default), positive(2), none(3). Vanilla uses only negative/positive in practice.

params.desc: One of: negative, neutral, positive, none.

examples.note: Red tooltip; DoTs usually set this negative.

effects.name: (see gain_random_quirk_positive_percentage)
effects.summary: Alias note: the positive-quirk grant is expressed as gain_random_quirk_positive_percentage (a percent), not a bare bool. Prefer that field.

examples.note: Canonical form of the positive-quirk grant.

effects.name: Monster-Type Gate
effects.summary: Conditions/bonuses the effect vs a monster type. Combined with .keyStatus to set the instant flag. (For buff-side conditions, use a rule_type on the buff instead.)

params.desc: man, unholy, beast, eldritch, vampire, husk, corpse.

effects.name: Requires Burning Target
effects.summary: Gates the effect on the target's Burning status — only lands if the target is on fire.

effects.name: Requires Not-Burning Target
effects.summary: Gates the effect on the target NOT being Burning.

examples.note: Only applies if the target is not burning.

effects.name: Can Apply On Corpse
effects.summary: Allows the effect to apply to a corpse target.

effects.name: Can Apply On Death
effects.summary: Allows the effect to apply even when the target is dying/dead. REQUIRED on move effects (push/pull/shuffle) — validator warns if a move effect lacks it.

effects.name: Swap Source and Target
effects.summary: Swaps the performer and target roles for this effect (resolves against the swapped actors). The Antiquarian 'Protect Me' pattern — make an ally guard the performer.

examples.note: The targeted ally guards the performer instead.

effects.name: Performer-Rank Target
effects.summary: When true, rank targeting is resolved from the performer's rank rather than the target's.

params.desc: Bool. Resolve rank from the performer.

examples.note: Rank targeting is relative to the performer.

effects.name: Requires In Inventory
effects.summary: Condition: the effect requires the (trinket/item) be in inventory.

examples.note: Only fires if the item is held.

effects.name: Key / Quest Status
effects.summary: A key/quest-status token (hashed). Also drives the instant-skill-style flag together with .monsterType.

effects.name: Individual Target Rolls
effects.summary: Per-target independent rolls (each target of an AoE rolls separately).

effects.name: Affliction-Blockable Chance
effects.summary: Chance the effect is blocked while the target is Afflicted (companion to virtue_blockable_chance). Parser-confirmed valid, unused in base.

examples.note: 50% blocked when the target is Afflicted.

effects.name: Virtue-Blockable Chance
effects.summary: Probability the effect is blocked while the target is Virtued (companion to affliction_blockable_chance).

examples.note: 50% blocked when the target is Virtued.

effects.name: Rank Target (set)
effects.summary: Explicit rank-target set. Parser-confirmed valid, unused in base.

effects.name: Clear Rank Target
effects.summary: Clears/targets a specific rank. The '@' form (e.g. @N) is the alternate/absolute rank encoding.

params.desc: Rank digit, or @N for absolute-rank encoding.

effects.name: Effect Name
effects.summary: The effect's unique identifier — always the first field. Hashed and used as the registry key; referenced by skills/trinkets/quirks. Reuse a vanilla name to reuse its art/behaviour.

effects.name: Effect Target
effects.summary: Who the effect resolves against. 11 values. Steal requires target/target_group; buff/heal application gate on target(1)/target_group(4); summon requires performer.

params.desc: performer, target, performer_group, performer_group_other, target_group, target_group_other, target_enemy_group, target_enemy_rank, target_enemy_random, this_trinket, global.

examples.note: Resolves against the performer's party except the performer.

effects.name: Effect Chance
effects.summary: Proc chance of the effect vs the roll (typically 100% since skill accuracy already gated the hit). Core application gate for stun/dot/kill/etc.

examples.note: Always applies once the hit lands.

effects.name: On Hit
effects.summary: Whether the effect fires on a hit result. One of on_hit / on_miss is REQUIRED (unless .item) — validator errors otherwise.

examples.note: The common trigger for offensive effects.

effects.name: On Miss
effects.summary: Whether the effect fires on a miss result. One of on_hit / on_miss is REQUIRED (unless .item).

examples.note: Fires even when the attack misses (e.g. self-move on lunge).

effects.name: Queue
effects.summary: Marks the effect as applied on the queued/turn-resolution pass rather than immediately. Required for stun/stress/torch; forbidden for move/control effects.

params.desc: Bool. Apply on the queued pass.

effects.name: Apply Once
effects.summary: For AoE: apply the payload once, not per target. Warns if a skill-instant apply-once effect has a team target type.

params.desc: Bool. Apply once across an AoE.

examples.note: One application for a group effect.

effects.name: Apply With Result
effects.summary: Flag: the effect application is gated on / carries the parent skill's hit result.

params.desc: Bool. Carry the parent skill's hit result.

examples.note: Ties application to the parent skill's result.

effects.name: Duration
effects.summary: Number of rounds/turns for the DoT/buff/riposte/guard applied. Every DoT branch scales by this. Validated non-zero for riposte/guard effects.

effects.name: Bark
effects.summary: Localization/bark id spoken when the effect fires (a line of flavour text).

examples.note: Plays a bark when the effect fires.

effects.name: Has Description
effects.summary: Marks whether the effect shows a description string in tooltips.

effects.name: Crit Doesn't Apply To Roll
effects.summary: When set, a critical roll on this effect does not affect the effect's own success roll (crit is cosmetic/damage-only, not re-rolled).

params.desc: Bool. Crit does not affect this effect's roll.

examples.note: Crit affects damage only, not the effect's success roll.

effects.name: Skill Instant
effects.summary: Marks the effect as an instantly-resolving skill. Validator warns if it lacks 100% chance, lacks a performer target, or is apply_once with a team target.

examples.note: Instant effect; needs 100% chance + performer target.

effects.name: Is Trigger Effect
effects.summary: Marks the effect as trigger-fired (vs directly applied).

examples.note: Fired by a trigger rather than directly.

effects.name: Item (grant/consume)
effects.summary: Grants/consumes an item count. In the validator it lets an effect skip the on_hit/on_miss requirement; the grant is handled by the inventory routine.

examples.note: Grants an item; exempt from on_hit/on_miss.

effects.name: Damage Type
effects.summary: The damage category, passed to the damage vcall. 20 values; idx 0 unknown is default, 0x14 invalid triggers a validation error.

params.desc: unknown, trap, obstacle, hunger, attack, bleed, healing, poisoned, captor, ddexit, townexit, death, heartattack, theblood, effect, quirkevolutiondeath, reflect, riposte, additionaleffect, burn.

examples.note: Attributes the direct HP damage as effect-sourced.

effects.name: Damage Source Type
effects.summary: Who/what the damage is attributed to. 14 values; idx 0 unknown is default, 0xe invalid triggers a validation error.

params.desc: unknown, hunger, trap, obstacle, friendly, monster, hero, friendly_quirk_actout, friendly_trait_actout, item, effect, quirk, reflect, trinket.

examples.note: Attributes the damage to an effect source.

effects.name: Damage Source Data
effects.summary: Identifies the source-data id for damage attribution (hashed), passed alongside the damage call.

examples.note: Extra attribution id for the damage.

effects.name: Skips Endless-Wave Curio
effects.summary: Pure data flag consumed by endless-wave/curio logic — marks the effect to skip the endless-wave curio.

effects.name: Guaranteed Town Event
effects.summary: Flags a guaranteed town event trigger. Town-flow effect; not read in combat apply.

effects.name: Battle-Start Effect (actor def)
effects.summary: NOT a standalone effect field — an ACTOR-definition token (.battle_start_effect_ids, a list) parsed into the actor's mode struct; those effects fire at combat start.

params.desc: Effect ids that fire when battle starts (up to 8).

examples.note: Applied on the actor definition, not an effect record.

effects.name: Continue Turn (free cast)
effects.summary: SKILL field, not an effect: the skill does not end the turn (a free cast / bonus action). Usually paired with .per_turn_limit.

effects.name: Ignore Stealth
effects.summary: SKILL field: the skill can target stealthed actors.

effects.name: Ignore Guard
effects.summary: SKILL field: the skill bypasses guard redirection and hits the intended target.

examples.note: Ignores a guardian and hits the real target.

effects.name: Move On Use (skill)
effects.summary: SKILL field: the performer moves forward/back when using the skill (fires even on miss — the Lance/Point-Blank pattern).

params.desc: Ranks forward and back the performer moves.

examples.note: Advances one rank when using the skill.

effects.name: Valid Modes (skill)
effects.summary: SKILL field: which modes/stances the skill is usable in (pairs with the effect .set_mode). The stance-gating half of the Thorn/Cook pattern.

params.desc: One or more mode names the skill works in.

examples.note: Skill only usable in the aggressive stance.

effects.name: Per-Battle Limit (skill)
effects.summary: SKILL field: how many times the skill can be used per battle.

effects.name: Per-Turn Limit (skill)
effects.summary: SKILL field: how many times the skill can be used per turn (often paired with is_continue_turn).

effects.name: Self-Target Valid (skill)
effects.summary: SKILL field: the skill can target the performer itself.

effects.name: Extra Targets Chance (skill)
effects.summary: SKILL field: chance to hit extra targets beyond the primary (paired with extra_targets_count).

effects.name: Extra Targets Count (skill)
effects.summary: SKILL field: how many extra targets can be struck (paired with extra_targets_chance).

effects.name: Can Crit (skill)
effects.summary: SKILL field: whether the skill can critically hit.

effects.name: Launch Ranks (skill)
effects.summary: SKILL field: which ranks the skill can be cast from (rank-string).

params.desc: Rank digits where the skill is castable; ~ negates.

effects.name: Target Geometry (skill)
effects.summary: SKILL field (.target on the combat_skill line): what ranks the skill hits. '~'=AoE, '@'=ally/self. Distinct from the effect-record .target.

params.desc: Rank-string of hittable ranks; ~ = AoE, @ = ally/self.
